title: Goal closure accepts the live loop's node evidence: review acceptance, verifier receipt, landing receipt
description:
SPIDR child 1 of task-d1c815ebc33346dfb0e837692e2166b5 (leaf; no sibling dependency). Filed by architect-16a01670 2026-09-04, measured at main 68eb1c5d.

WHAT THIS ROW OWNS: the per-NODE verification leg of `goal.close` qualification. Goal-level readiness (criteria coverage), the affordance offer gate, UI, docs and the live drive belong to children 2 and 3.

MEASURED (corrects the parent description; re-measure before planning):
- apps/daemon/src/goals/goal-qualification.ts (248 lines) ALREADY reads the live loop's review evidence: `reviewClosure` (:95-137) requires `readReviewLedger(...).accepted` (the `integration.accept_output` acceptance), refuses on a re-plan delta, reads the verifier receipt by `accepted.verifierReceiptId` through `readVerifierReceipt` (apps/daemon/src/review/verifier-receipt-ledger.ts:85 - NOT orchestrator/ as the parent says) and checks its sha256 + reviewInputDigest + the latest review round. `VerifierReceiptV1.proof` is always "PASSED" by construction (verifier-receipt-contracts.ts:47, decoder refuses anything else at :207).
- What is FOUNDATION-ONLY: `qualify` (:199-233) first demands a Foundation verification RECEIPTED row per node via `indexDurableReceipts` (goal-qualification-reads.ts:108-148, keyed by graphIdentity; a node with no rows is simply absent from the index) and refuses GOAL_CLOSE_VERIFICATION_RECEIPT_ABSENT at :213-216 - this is where the three UnAI goals die; `verifiedResultHolds` (:151) and `zeroAuthority` (:139-166, Foundation activation accounts; nodes absent from its map are skipped by `continue`) and `compose` (:168-197) derive every witness ref from `entry.receipt.*` (DurableReceipt: receiptSha256, attemptAggregateId, leaseIdentity, effectIdentity, obligations).
- Landing evidence: `readReviewLedgers(store, projectId, subjectRefs)` (review/review-read-model.ts:287) folds `landings: Map<subjectRef, LandingReceiptV1>` (repository/landing-receipt-contracts.ts:56-67: outcome COMMITTED|REFUSED, refusal {code}, verifierReceiptId, commit) keyed by the BARE node key; the lander's legitimate refusal code is "NOTHING_TO_COMMIT" (orchestrator/node-lander.ts:150).
- Core's closure witness is an EXACT key roster (packages/core/src/goal/goal-validation.ts:27,:160: acceptanceClosureRef, completionNodeAcceptedRef, noCurrentPreparationGeneration, noPendingDraftOrSupersession, obligationsHoldRef, truthClass) - a `leg` key inside the witness is refused by core; the leg goes into the DERIVED REFS and into a daemon-side `legs` field on the qualification result (goal-services.ts:149-160 passes only the two witnesses to core).
- GOAL_PREREQUISITE_REFUSAL_CODES (goal-close-prerequisite.ts:34-44) is re-exported from the daemon root and pinned by index-surface.test.ts, runtime-entrypoint.test.ts, goal-services.test.ts and foundation-surface.ts - adding a code is a 5-consumer backfill; this row adds NONE and distinguishes by MESSAGE (the roster's own comment: two codes are raised by more than one guard; the message tells them apart).
- Fixtures: goal-closure-test-fixtures.ts:697 `seedReviewAcceptance(store, nodeRef)` writes a verifier receipt + `integration.accept_output` through the REAL command path (a live acceptance with no Foundation rows); `approveNodes(store, nodeRefs)` (:675) approves the scope; `seedVerifiedNode` (:593) is the Foundation path; `recordLandingReceipt(store, input)` (repository/landing-ledger.ts:153) writes a landing receipt; `driveThrough(store, upToKind)` (bootstrap/bootstrap-test-fixtures.ts:652) drives the production sequence.

FEATURE: for each approved node, when NO Foundation receipt names it, `qualify` takes the LIVE leg instead of refusing: `reviewClosure` (unchanged: acceptance + verifier receipt PASSED + not stale) PLUS the landing rule - a landing receipt for the node, when one exists, must be COMMITTED or REFUSED with code NOTHING_TO_COMMIT; any other refusal code refuses closure with GOAL_CLOSE_VERIFICATION_NOT_PASSED and a message naming the landing code; no landing receipt at all is admitted (landing off, or a pre-feature node) and recorded as landing "NONE". `NodeClosure` becomes a union {leg:"FOUNDATION", receipt, accepted, nodeRef} | {leg:"LIVE", accepted, verifierReceiptSha256, landing: "COMMITTED"|"NOTHING_TO_COMMIT"|"NONE", landingReceiptId: string|null, nodeRef}; `zeroAuthority` maps only FOUNDATION entries; `compose` derives acceptanceClosureRef / obligationsHoldRef / zeroAuthorityProofRef from each entry's own evidence with the leg tag in the ref preimage (a Foundation proof and a live proof of the same node never derive the same ref); `GoalClosureQualified` gains `legs: Readonly<Record<nodeRef, "FOUNDATION"|"LIVE">>`. The Foundation path stays byte-identical: goal-qualification.test.ts is NOT edited.
definitionOfDone: Over a REAL SqliteEventStore driven by the production sequence (driveThrough + approveNodes + seedReviewAcceptance + recordLandingReceipt, no fixture records): `goal.close` dispatched through handleCommandRequest for a goal whose only node carries acceptance + verifier receipt + landing COMMITTED commits `GoalCompleted`; `qualifyGoalClosure` for that goal answers ok with `legs[node] === "LIVE"` and the closure witness passes core (`reduceGoal` accepts it - proven by the commit).

Refusal arms asserted with code + layer DAEMON_PREREQUISITE + the distinguishing message: node approved but never accepted -> GOAL_CLOSE_REVIEW_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED; landing receipt REFUSED with a code other than NOTHING_TO_COMMIT -> GOAL_CLOSE_VERIFICATION_NOT_PASSED with the landing code in the message; landing REFUSED NOTHING_TO_COMMIT -> ok; no landing receipt -> ok with landing NONE; a re-plan delta -> GOAL_CLOSE_REVIEW_PACKAGE_STALE (existing arm re-asserted on the live leg). Each arm verified red by mutating the production surface.

Mixed goal (one Foundation-verified node via seedVerifiedNode + one live node) closes with `legs` naming both; the Foundation-only arms are byte-identical: `git diff --stat` shows apps/daemon/src/goals/goal-qualification.test.ts UNCHANGED and its count line quoted; witness refs for a live node differ from a Foundation-proven node with the same nodeRef (test asserts inequality).

No new refusal code and no new *_LAYER: `git diff` of goal-close-prerequisite.ts is empty and GOAL_PREREQUISITE_REFUSAL_CODES pins (index-surface.test.ts, runtime-entrypoint.test.ts, goal-services.test.ts) are untouched; the live leg lives in a new module apps/daemon/src/goals/goal-live-evidence.ts (+ .js bridge) and goal-qualification.ts does not grow past 250 lines (`wc -l` both quoted).

Gates quoted with count lines: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm typecheck`; focused run `pnpm exec vitest run --root . --config package.json src/goals/goal-live-evidence.test.ts src/goals/goal-qualification.test.ts src/goals/goal-services.test.ts` from apps/daemon.
taskRails: PURE DAEMON LEAF: no affordance/offer change, no UI, no docs, no coverage/criteria check (child 2), no live drive (child 3). If a step needs one of those, stop and say so.

FOUNDATION PATH BYTE-IDENTICAL: goal-qualification.test.ts is not edited; every Foundation arm stays green unchanged; the seed journey (bootstrap-finalize-journey.test.ts, j1-command-path.test.ts) stays green.

No new refusal code, no new *_LAYER (both are multi-file roster backfills); distinguish by message. <=250 physical lines per production source, hard stop 400. Refusals assert code AND layer AND message; mutate the surface to prove each arm red (global rail 1).

implementationPlan.description: LIVE-LEG TESTS FIRST (red). Create apps/daemon/src/goals/goal-live-evidence.test.ts using the same harness as goal-qualification.test.ts (openStore, cleanupGoalClosureFixtures, PROJECT_ID, GOAL_ID, `approvedWorld` = approveNodes + seedReviewAcceptance from goal-closure-test-fixtures.ts:675/:697, snapshot/expectUnmoved). Add to goal-closure-test-fixtures.ts (fixtures are exempt from the line cap) a helper `seedLandingReceipt(store, nodeRef, outcome: "COMMITTED" | { refusalCode: string })` that calls `recordLandingReceipt(store, { commit, decidedAt, projectId: PROJECT_ID, refusal, subjectRef: nodeRef, verifierReceiptId: <the id seedReviewAcceptance recorded - return it from seedReviewAcceptance or read it back through readReviewLedger(...).accepted.verifierReceiptId>, workspace })` (repository/landing-ledger.ts:153, input shape :39-47). ARMS (each names code + layer 'DAEMON_PREREQUISITE' + message through `expectRefusedExactly`, and asserts `expectUnmoved` - qualification is a read): (1) approved + accepted, landing COMMITTED -> `qualifyGoalClosure` ok with `legs` = {node-1:'LIVE'} and both witnesses present; (2) landing REFUSED NOTHING_TO_COMMIT -> ok; (3) landing REFUSED 'GIT_COMMIT_FAILED' -> refused GOAL_CLOSE_VERIFICATION_NOT_PASSED, message 'the landing receipt refused GIT_COMMIT_FAILED'; (4) no landing receipt -> ok and the live leg records landing 'NONE' (assert through an exported pure `landingOf(receipt|undefined)` or the `legs` detail - state which); (5) approved but NOT accepted -> GOAL_CLOSE_REVIEW_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED (unchanged message); (6) MIXED goal: seedVerifiedNode(store, ACTIVATION_WORLD_NODE_KEY) + seedReviewAcceptance for it (the Foundation pattern at goal-qualification.test.ts:323-348) plus a live node-2 -> ok, legs {ACTIVATION_WORLD_NODE_KEY:'FOUNDATION', node-2:'LIVE'}; (7) REF INEQUALITY: the closure witness refs of arm 1 differ from the refs of a Foundation-proven goal with the same nodeRef (build both worlds in two stores, compare acceptanceClosureRef and zeroAuthorityProofRef with `not.toBe`); (8) REAL COMMAND PATH (DoD 1): mirror goal-services.test.ts:258-304 - `driveThrough(store, <the bootstrap kind immediately preceding "goal.close" in BOOTSTRAP sequence order; read apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/bootstrap-sequence.ts and name it in the test comment>)`, then approveNodes + seedReviewAcceptance + seedLandingReceipt COMMITTED for the goal's node, then `send(store, envelope("goal.close", <version>, acceptancePayload()))` -> ok, resultCode/lifecycle COMPLETED and a `GoalCompleted` event in the store (read it back); a second close on the same goal is refused by core (existing lifecycle arm, code asserted). Run from apps/daemon: `pnpm exec vitest run --root . --config package.json src/goals/goal-live-evidence.test.ts` - RED (module missing); quote the failing line.

NEW MODULE apps/daemon/src/goals/goal-live-evidence.ts (<=250 physical lines) + bridge apps/daemon/src/goals/goal-live-evidence.js (`export * from "./goal-live-evidence.ts";`). Exports: `type ClosureLeg = Readonly<{ leg: "FOUNDATION"; accepted: AcceptanceRecord; nodeRef: string; receipt: DurableReceipt }> | Readonly<{ leg: "LIVE"; accepted: AcceptanceRecord; landing: "COMMITTED" | "NOTHING_TO_COMMIT" | "NONE"; landingReceiptId: string | null; nodeRef: string; verifierReceiptSha256: string }>`; `readLiveNodeEvidence(store, projectId, nodeRef, accepted): ClosureLeg | GoalClosureRefused` - reads `readReviewLedgers(store, projectId, new Set([nodeRef])).landings.get(nodeRef)` (review/review-read-model.ts:287; the map is keyed by the BARE node key): undefined -> landing NONE; outcome COMMITTED -> COMMITTED with receiptId; outcome REFUSED with refusal.code === "NOTHING_TO_COMMIT" (the lander's own literal, orchestrator/node-lander.ts:150 - import nothing from the orchestrator, spell the literal and cite it) -> NOTHING_TO_COMMIT; any other refusal -> `refuse(GOAL_CLOSE_VERIFICATION_NOT_PASSED, `the landing receipt refused ${code}`)`; `verifierReceiptSha256 = accepted.verifierReceiptSha256`; the whole read wrapped so a thrown store answers the caller's fail-closed path (return the refusal, never throw). `composeClosure(approvalRef, nodes, legs: readonly ClosureLeg[], activations): GoalClosureQualified` - MOVED from goal-qualification.ts:168-197 and generalised: the acceptance preimage per entry is [leg, nodeRef, ...(FOUNDATION ? [receipt.receiptSha256] : [verifierReceiptSha256, landing, landingReceiptId ?? "NONE"]), accepted.verifierReceiptSha256, accepted.reviewInputDigest]; obligationsHoldRef per entry [leg, nodeRef, FOUNDATION ? receipt.obligations : verifierReceiptSha256]; zeroAuthorityProofRef [String(activations), ...FOUNDATION entries' leaseIdentity/effectIdentity, ...LIVE entries' ["LIVE", nodeRef]] - the leg tag is in every preimage so a Foundation proof and a live proof of one node never derive the same ref; the witness objects keep EXACTLY core's key roster (packages/core/src/goal/goal-validation.ts:27); the result adds `legs: Object.freeze(Object.fromEntries(legs.map((l) => [l.nodeRef, l.leg])))` as a sibling field (goal-services.ts:149-160 passes only the two witnesses to core). Move `derivedRef` (goal-qualification.ts:87-93) along with compose or import it - one copy only. Keep `GoalClosureQualified`/`GoalClosureRefused`/`refuse` where they are and import them.

WIRE THE LEG INTO goal-qualification.ts (248 lines today; removing compose/derivedRef must leave it <= 250 - quote `wc -l`). In `qualify` (:199-233): after `indexDurableReceipts`, for each nodeRef: `const receipt = indexed.index.get(nodeRef); const accepted = reviewClosure(store, projectId, nodeRef); if ("ok" in accepted) return accepted;` (reviewClosure FIRST for both legs - it is what both share: acceptance present, no re-plan delta, verifier receipt reads back and matches, latest round attested); then `if (receipt !== undefined) { if (receipt.verdict !== "PASSED") refuse NOT_PASSED (unchanged message); if (!verifiedResultHolds(store, receipt)) refuse RESULT_DIGEST_MISMATCH (unchanged); legs.push({ leg: "FOUNDATION", accepted, nodeRef, receipt }); } else { const live = readLiveNodeEvidence(store, projectId, nodeRef, accepted); if ("ok" in live) return live; legs.push(live); }`. NOTE the ORDER CHANGE for Foundation nodes (reviewClosure now runs before the verdict/digest checks): the Foundation arms at goal-qualification.test.ts:470-476 (NOT_PASSED) and the digest arm build worlds with acceptance present, so their codes are unchanged - re-run the whole file after wiring and confirm every arm except :378-390 is green UNTOUCHED; if any other arm's expected code changes because of the order, restore the original order for Foundation nodes (verdict/digest before reviewClosure) and take the live leg only in the `receipt === undefined` branch - the byte-identity of the Foundation path outranks the tidier order. `zeroAuthority` builds its map from FOUNDATION legs only (`legs.filter((l) => l.leg === "FOUNDATION")`), everything else unchanged. Replace the local `NodeClosure` interface (:79-83) and `compose` with the imports from ./goal-live-evidence.js. Then edit EXACTLY ONE arm in apps/daemon/src/goals/goal-qualification.test.ts: :378-390 becomes 'closes through the LIVE leg for an approved, accepted node no Foundation receipt names' asserting ok:true, `legs` equal {node-1:'LIVE', node-2:'LIVE'} and `expectUnmoved(store, before)`; `git diff -U0 -- apps/daemon/src/goals/goal-qualification.test.ts` must show that single hunk (quote it in the step note). Run from apps/daemon: `pnpm exec vitest run --root . --config package.json src/goals/goal-live-evidence.test.ts src/goals/goal-qualification.test.ts src/goals/goal-services.test.ts src/bootstrap/bootstrap-finalize-journey.test.ts src/goals/j1-command-path.test.ts` - green, count line quoted.

VERIFICATION GATE + DRILL. From the repo root: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` (quote `Test Files N passed` + `Tests N passed`), `pnpm typecheck` (quote the `$ tsc` echo); `wc -l apps/daemon/src/goals/goal-qualification.ts apps/daemon/src/goals/goal-live-evidence.ts` both <= 250; `git diff -- apps/daemon/src/goals/goal-close-prerequisite.ts` empty (no new code, DoD 4); `git status --porcelain` shows no file outside the six this plan names (peer dirt scripts/up.ps1, scripts/watch.ps1, .moe/messages/* is never staged). DRILL (global rail 1) - new files are untracked until the completion commit: back both new production/test files up to %TEMP%\moe-drill-<workerId>\ with SHA256 first; tracked files restore-proven with `git diff --exit-code -- <file>`. One mutation at a time, focused run, SHA256/diff-proven restore in a SEPARATE command: (1) landing 'GIT_COMMIT_FAILED' treated as ok -> arm 3 red; (2) NOTHING_TO_COMMIT treated as a refusal -> arm 2 red; (3) drop the leg tag from the acceptance preimage -> arm 7 (ref inequality) red; (4) zeroAuthority maps LIVE legs too (reading `receipt` off a live entry) -> arm 6 (mixed) red or throws - either is the proof; (5) `legs` omitted from the result -> arms 1 and 6 red; (6) reviewClosure skipped on the live leg -> arm 5 red. Record the six red lines + restore proofs in the step note (under 4500 chars).

ADVERSARIAL SELF-REVIEW + COMPLETE. Load the adversarial-self-review skill and read the diff as an attacker: a landing receipt whose `verifierReceiptId` names a DIFFERENT verifier receipt than the acceptance's (a stale landing from a previous round) - decide and test: the live leg must require `landing.verifierReceiptId === accepted.verifierReceiptId` when a landing exists, else refuse GOAL_CLOSE_REVIEW_PACKAGE_STALE with message 'the landing receipt attests a different verifier receipt' (add the arm to goal-live-evidence.test.ts); two landing receipts for one node (the map holds the latest by fold order - state which wins and pin it); a goal with zero approved nodes (existing behaviour, unchanged); `readReviewLedgers` throwing -> refusal, not a throw (qualifyGoalClosure's outer catch is the last line of defence - do not rely on it, wrap in the module). Fix what you find, re-run the focused files, then `moe.complete_task` with verification = `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` and its fresh count line; completionSummary names: the exported ClosureLeg union and readLiveNodeEvidence/composeClosure, the single re-aimed arm (quote the hunk header), the declared-but-unreachable GOAL_CLOSE_VERIFICATION_RECEIPT_ABSENT (per comment on this row), and the `legs` seam child 2 (task-8145137c) reads. Then `moe.add_comment` on child 2 with that seam and the fixture helper name. Report every touched path in complete_step.modifiedFiles.

comments.content: DoD 3 + RAIL 2 RE-ANCHOR (architect-16a01670, plan time, measured at main 68eb1c5d): apps/daemon/src/goals/goal-qualification.test.ts:378-390 "refuses RECEIPT_ABSENT for an approved node no verification receipt names" builds `approvedWorld(store, ["node-1","node-2"])` = approved + review-ACCEPTED nodes with NO Foundation receipt - precisely the world this row makes closable through the LIVE leg. "goal-qualification.test.ts is not edited" is therefore unsatisfiable as written. Read DoD 3 and rail 2 as: EXACTLY ONE arm changes - :378-390 is re-aimed to assert the LIVE success (ok:true, legs {node-1:"LIVE", node-2:"LIVE"}, store unmoved) - and every other arm stays byte-identical (`git diff -U0 -- apps/daemon/src/goals/goal-qualification.test.ts` shows that single hunk; quote it). Consequence to record: GOAL_CLOSE_VERIFICATION_RECEIPT_ABSENT stays DECLARED in the roster (vocabulary stability, goal-services.test.ts:156 pins the list) but becomes unreachable, because a node with no Foundation receipt now takes the live leg and a missing acceptance answers GOAL_CLOSE_REVIEW_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED first; the bidirectional "codes the closure surface can emit" arm in child 2 must treat it as declared-unreachable (list it explicitly), never delete it.

planSizeWarnings: Plan touches 6 distinct files (target <=5); plans over 10 are rejected. Small file-disjoint tasks review better and parallelize.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (1) Keep the Foundation receipt mandatory and add a 'live' bypass flag - REJECTED: a flag is exactly the fail-open the design forbids; the live leg has its own evidence (acceptance + verifier receipt already checked by reviewClosure, plus the landing rule). (2) A new refusal code for a refused landing - REJECTED: GOAL_PREREQUISITE_REFUSAL_CODES has 5 pinned consumers; GOAL_CLOSE_VERIFICATION_NOT_PASSED with a distinguishing message follows the roster's own convention. (3) Putting `leg` inside the closure witness - REJECTED: core validates the witness with an exact key roster (goal-validation.ts:27,:160); the leg lives in every derived-ref preimage and in a sibling `legs` field. (4) Growing goal-qualification.ts in place - REJECTED (248 lines): compose/derivedRef move into the new module so the file shrinks. (5) Leaving goal-qualification.test.ts byte-identical - IMPOSSIBLE: its RECEIPT_ABSENT arm (:378-390) builds the approved+accepted, receipt-less world the feature makes closable; exactly that arm is re-aimed (recorded in the row comment). (6) Requiring a landing receipt for every live node - REJECTED: landing is a wrapper knob (MOE_NODE_LANDING=0) and pre-feature nodes have none; absence is admitted and recorded as NONE, presence is checked strictly.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: Measured 2026-09-04 at main 68eb1c5d: goal-qualification.ts qualify :199-233 (Foundation receipt demanded at :213-216), reviewClosure :95-137 (acceptance, delta, verifier receipt read-back via review/verifier-receipt-ledger.ts:85, sha/digest/latest-round checks), zeroAuthority :139-166 (maps bound entries by receipt; skips accounts naming unmapped nodes), compose :168-197 + derivedRef :87-93, local NodeClosure :79-83, refuse :74, qualifyGoalClosure :239-248 (outer catch). goal-qualification-reads.ts: DurableReceipt :20, indexDurableReceipts :108-148, verifiedResultHolds :151. Landing evidence: readReviewLedgers(store, projectId, subjectRefs).landings (review-read-model.ts:287, :274-279 ReviewLedgers), LandingReceiptV1 (landing-receipt-contracts.ts:56-67), recordLandingReceipt + RecordLandingReceiptInput (landing-ledger.ts:153, :39-47), NOTHING_TO_COMMIT literal at node-lander.ts:150. Core witness keys: goal-validation.ts:27,:160. goal-services.ts closeGoal :141-175 passes qualified.closureWitness/zeroAuthorityWitness to reduceGoal. Fixtures: goal-closure-test-fixtures.ts approveNodes :675, seedReviewAcceptance :697 (real command path via integration.accept_output), seedVerifiedNode :593; goal-qualification.test.ts approvedWorld :234-237, expectRefusedExactly :226-230, Foundation pattern :323-348, RECEIPT_ABSENT arm :378-390; goal-services.test.ts real-path close arm :258-304 (driveThrough + envelope + acceptancePayload).
planningNotes.risks: (a) Re-ordering reviewClosure before the Foundation verdict/digest checks could change an existing Foundation arm's code - step 3 says restore the original order for Foundation nodes if any arm other than :378-390 moves. (b) GOAL_CLOSE_VERIFICATION_RECEIPT_ABSENT becomes declared-but-unreachable; child 2's bidirectional roster arm must list it explicitly. (c) A stale landing (different verifierReceiptId) is a real attack surface - step 5 adds the arm. (d) `readReviewLedgers` folds ALL subjects it is given; pass exactly one nodeRef to keep the read cheap. (e) New files untracked until the completion commit: drill restores proven by SHA256; peer dirt never staged. (f) Windows temp stores: cleanupGoalClosureFixtures already handles the sqlite handle; keep using it.
